verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a product-catalog API and MCP server that lets agents in ChatGPT and Claude search and look up products. The evidence shows only buy URLs and affiliate sale attribution, with no documented in-chat checkout for merchants' products. MCP and UCP support is described as search and lookup only, and MPP covers agents paying for API access rather than buyers purchasing merchandise, so neither counts as agent checkout.

support.subject: As a merchant, buyers can complete purchases of my products inside chat and assistant surfaces (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot and peers)
